description: This file contains a FastAPI application with multiple routes illustrating the handling of 'File' and 'Form' parameters, as well as test cases verifying order dependency issues between form fields and files. It is a test script demonstrating a regression scenario related to the order of parameters in FastAPI endpoints.

methods.name: file_before_form( file: bytes = File(), city: str = Form(), )
methods.description: FastAPI POST endpoint that receives a file as bytes and a city name as form data, returning their contents.

methods.name: file_after_form( city: str = Form(), file: bytes = File(), )
methods.description: FastAPI POST endpoint with parameters ordered differently, receiving a city name and a file, returning their contents.

methods.name: file_list_before_form( files: Annotated[list[bytes], File()], city: Annotated[str, Form()], )
methods.description: FastAPI POST endpoint that accepts a list of files and a city name as form data, returning the contents of the files.

methods.name: file_list_after_form( city: Annotated[str, Form()], files: Annotated[list[bytes], File()], )
methods.description: FastAPI POST endpoint with parameters ordered differently, accepting a city name and a list of files, returning the file contents.

methods.description: Pytest test function that tests list of files handling with different parameter orders, verifying server response.
